argv:

import json, urllib.request
for model in ['qwen2.5:xavi-agent','qwen2.5-coder:xavi-agent']:

PY

idleTime=0
suspendType=0

    item=env.get(k)
    if not item:
        print(f'{k}: MISSING')
        continue
    n,v=item
    safe=v
    if re.search(r'(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)', k, re.I):
        safe='REDACTED'
    print(f'{k} line {n}: {safe!r}')

print('\n== URL validation ==')
for k,(n,v) in sorted(env.items()):
    if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['URL','URI','HOST','BASE','DOMAIN']) or 'UPSTREAM' in k.upper():

        k,v=s.split('=',1); k=k.strip(); v=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")

from pathlib import Path

            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=profile.timeout) as client:

            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=profile.timeout) as resp:

                body = resp.read(200).decode("utf-8", "replace")
            profile.healthy = status_code == 200
            profile.status = "ok" if profile.healthy else f"http_{status_code}"
            profile.last_error = "" if profile.healthy else body
        except Exception as exc:

'''

PY
